condition: Eosinophilic oesophagitis (recurrent food bolus in an atopic young man)
summary: 26-year-old man with asthma and eczema, third food bolus impaction this year.

inputs.hpi: Food keeps sticking behind the breastbone; third food bolus this year, cleared by itself today. Dysphagia to solids for years, eats slowly. Asthma and eczema since childhood; hay fever.

mustInclude.note: Dysphagia / food bolus with atopy or eosinophilia fits EoE (AGREE 2018); OGD with biopsies from two levels.

guideline.name: Updated international consensus diagnostic criteria for eosinophilic esophagitis (AGREE)

rationale: The zebra check should offer EoE for the recurrent bolus + atopy combination.
